telemetryLocalPorts: localPorts is a row-aligned array of null (unreported) or sorted distinct local TCP/UDP port integers (1..65535), refreshed independently of topology. PID rows use the same full identity as telemetry topology.
telemetryListeningPorts: listeningPorts is row-aligned like localPorts and lists the subset of localPorts the process serves on: TCP listeners and UDP sockets bound to a well-known port (below 1024). Clients older than protocol 1.2 ignore it.
comment: ProcessLama's remote helper contract. tooling/remote_wire/generate.py emits rust-core/wire/src/contract.rs, lib/models/remote_contract.g.dart and lib/repositories/impl/remote/wire/contract.g.dart from it. Change this file, the helper and fixtures/remote_contract_vectors.json together, and raise rust-core/remote-helper/COMPATIBILITY.
